questions.subject: GEOMETRY
questions.learningObjective: Classify an angle by its measure
questions.stem: During the evening handover, Nurse Priya records that a patient bed is tilted 30 degrees from horizontal; classify this angle.

options.text: Acute, because 30 degrees is less than 90
Right, because tilt is measured from horizontal
options.misconception: confuses tilt reference with a right angle

options.text: Obtuse, because the bed is not flat
Straight, because the bed is nearly level
options.misconception: equates slight tilt with a straight angle

questions.explanation: An angle under 90 degrees is acute. The bed tilt of 30 degrees is less than 90, so it is acute, not right or obtuse.
